# doctest

Unmodified single-header distribution of
[doctest v2.5.3](https://github.com/doctest/doctest/releases/tag/v2.5.3),
licensed under the MIT license in [LICENSE.doctest.txt](LICENSE.doctest.txt).

Upstream files:

- [doctest.h](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doctest/doctest/v2.5.3/doctest/doctest.h)
- [LICENSE.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doctest/doctest/v2.5.3/LICENSE.txt)

SHA-256 checksums of the vendored files:

```text
cfd518a3ef90f67e1f3ba514df23fb3627437de1a2feeba78cf5062a40021421  doctest.h
0fe0b331fa1513dcce8604ff1fa925f32d1cea17d8aeb1c2471fad40d291adc5  LICENSE.doctest.txt
```

The header and license are checked in; building and running tests never downloads
dependencies. To update doctest, replace both files from a specific release and
update the version, links, and checksums here.
